title: Best Trash Can (2026)
summary: We're still testing and researching this guide. Picks will be added soon.
method: Selected products that appear in at least two of the cited sources (Simplehuman) and added complementary picks from the remaining sources. Sources used: consumerreports.org, cnet.com, pcmag.com, reviewed.com, techgearlab.com, bonappetit.com.
assumptions: Prices are omitted unless explicitly stated in a source; no price comparisons are made.

verdict.line: Picture a busy kitchen where you need a reliable, odor‑sealed bin that’s easy to empty. The Simplehuman Rectangular Step Trash Can offers a sturdy step‑lid, soft‑close mechanism, and a 13‑gallon capacity that keeps smells locked in. It outperforms other picks by combining a durable design with a quiet, smooth lid action that no other model in this guide matches. The catch: it is priced higher than the budget options.
